description.text: Learn about original writing, research, and revision collaboration for writers and authors, distinguish employee wages from freelance receipts, and use the fictional two drafts to experience audience, fact, and copyright boundaries.

subject.name: Writers and authors
subject.summary: Writers and authors correspond to O*NET27-3043.00, creating original written material such as stories, scripts, articles, and advertising, researching material, organizing structure, and adjusting tone for the audience and medium, and submitting to and revising with clients or editors. They may be employees, freelancers, or self-employed, and manuscript fees, royalties, project payments, and employee wages are verified separately. Writing is not the whole of editorial finalization, news gathering, technical writing, or marketing management. The paper exercise only uses a fictional event setting to write two drafts, without publishing or passing them off as actual client work.
